# GitHub Codespaces configuration
# This file optimizes the Codespaces experience for the OWLCMS project

# Codespaces will use the devcontainer configuration automatically
# Additional Codespaces-specific settings can be added here if needed

# The devcontainer.json handles:
# - JetBrains JDK with DCEVM installation
# - VS Code extensions
# - Maven setup
# - Port forwarding (8080, 8081, 1883)
# - Environment variables

# For more Codespaces configuration options, see:
# https://docs.github.com/en/codespaces/setting-up-your-project-for-codespaces
